choice_data_list: Are you not getting enough sleep?

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: I got a Japanese class assignment to write a haiku, but expressing myself freely is pretty tough...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I racked my brain, nothing came to mind,
and before I knew it, the night had grown late...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
"Red apple so red,
Delicious and sweet to eat,
Tasty little fruit."
Does this count as a haiku, you think...?

It seems Win Variation couldn't get a good rest,
troubled by her assignments.
